description: prov_arm create/entra passes the Entra parameter file, not another one.

patches.find:
create/entra)
        SAF_ENTRA_JSON="$(cat "$inputs")" az deployment group create --resource-group "$where" --name "$name" \
          --parameters "$prov_entra_param"
patches.replace:
create/entra)
        SAF_ENTRA_JSON="$(cat "$inputs")" az deployment group create --resource-group "$where" --name "$name" \
          --parameters "$prov_release_param"
